about: Development set for the POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUEST signal (D-074). Invented messages written fresh for this purpose; not copied from the tuned, held-out or sealed items. A development set is for making changes. Claims are made only on the sealed run. SYNTHETIC DATA: every customer and message is invented.

items.body: I've got a standing order of eight apartments to maintain. Is there some kind of reduced hourly rate if I send you all of them?
The quote seems steep for a job that I'm told takes about ten minutes. Would the technician agree to bill me only for the minutes worked?
Hello, could you put in writing that your plumber will arrive before 9am and that the total will not exceed $300? I need that for my records.
Another company quoted me $20 less for the same drain job. Can you come down to their price and I'll book today.
I'd rather pay in cash and skip the paperwork if that brings the cost down a bit. Does that work for you?
Your call-out fee was charged even though nobody could fix the problem. I think it should be dropped given the circumstances, please.
My neighbour says you did a favour for them last year and took care of a gas line. Could you do the same for me, just this once? I know it isn't normally your thing.
I'm a retired teacher on a fixed income. Is it at all possible to get something off the bill for the water heater flush?
Can I skip the estimate and just have your guy start on Monday? I trust you and I don't want to wait for a written quote.
I'd like you to extend the warranty on last month's repair to five years. I'm happy to pay a little extra for that.
We are a church hall with a leaking tap. Would you consider doing it at cost for a charity?
I booked a Friday slot and then the buyers pulled out. Please cancel without the late fee, my situation is hard enough as it is.
Can you promise the same plumber who came last time? And hold the price from the old quote even though it's been a year?
Look, I'll be honest, I can't afford the full emergency rate on a Sunday. Can you charge me the weekday rate instead?
Please bill the two flats to separate invoices and give me the multi-unit price on both even though they're in different buildings.
Is there any chance of a few dollars off? I'm a repeat customer, you did our kitchen in the spring.
I know you don't normally work on shops, but my bakery on Elm Row has a blocked sink and you're the only people I trust. Could you make an exception?
We won't be home to meet your technician. Can he be given the key from the lockbox and finish without anyone present, and can you guarantee he'll leave the place spotless?
Would your boss waive the booking deposit for me? I've used you four times without a problem.
I'd appreciate it if the invoice didn't show the full labour hours. Could it show only half and I'll settle it on the spot?
Do you offer any discounts for seniors or repeat customers?
How much is the call-out fee, and is it taken off the final bill if you do the work?
Can I pay by card on the day or do you only take cheques?
What's the warranty on a repair, and does it cover parts as well as labour?
I'd like to book a drain cleaning for my house in Wren Common on Thursday 5 November, mornings are best.
Do you give a written estimate before starting a job?
What happens if I need to cancel a booking the day before? Is there a fee?
How long does it usually take to replace a water heater, and what does it cost?
Do you work on weekends, and is there an extra charge for Sunday visits?
Do you service rental properties? I manage a few houses and want to know what you do.
My kitchen sink is draining slowly. What would a visit to look at it cost?
Which neighbourhoods do you cover, and is there a travel fee?
Please confirm the time of my appointment on Friday and whether someone needs to be home.
Do I need to pay anything up front when I book?
Can I get an invoice by email after the job for my accountant?
Is the call-out fee refundable if I decide not to go ahead after the technician has looked at the problem?
I need to move my Tuesday visit to the following week, reference KH-2231.
How do you price an emergency call at night? I'd like to know before I ever need one.
Do you do gas line work? I'm trying to work out who to call for a new cooker hookup.
Do you price match if I find a cheaper quote elsewhere?
The technician was late and left a mess. I want to tell you how unhappy I am with the service.
Do you offer a guarantee on the work, and how long does it last?
